anchor_population: same-split VALID, same true class, target excluded
adjacency: canonical public undirected nonself direct edges; directed target-anchor observations
degree: complete public unique undirected nonself degree
bank_confidence: mean member maximum FP32 softmax probability
neighbor_order: SHA256 of salt|node_id, lexicographic digest order
control_choice: minimum summed absolute bank confidence distance, same hash-order tie break
native_member_and_single: raw FP32-logit argmax, smallest class tie
primary: both pools wrong at same competitor and both banks erroneously unanimous; equal-target shared-minus-independent matched excess
erroneous_unanimity_flag: all raw members equal the native pool wrong competitor; raw-unanimity/pool-class discrepancies separately reported
